name: power-off-slide
title: Power Off Slide
description: An iOS-style power-off bar: a rounded pill with a dim shimmering label and a white knob holding a red power icon. Drag the knob past the end and the bar is replaced by a "Shutting down..." message.
use: A destructive or irreversible action needs a deliberate drag rather than a single easy click.
avoid: The knob only moves by drag, so keyboard and switch users cannot trigger it even though it takes focus.
a11y: The knob takes focus but only dragging moves it, and it has no role or label; reduced motion stops the shimmer and the snap. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A wide grey rounded pill with a soft border sits on a dark phone screen, its pale label centred and a white circular knob at the left holding a red power glyph. Around it the screen shows a large light clock, a date and a muted Cancel line.
behaves: Dragging the knob right slides it along the track while a brighter band sweeps across the label. Past the threshold the knob snaps to the end, the pill is swapped for a "Shutting down..." sentence, and after the set duration the bar slides back.
customise: Change the label, the shutdown duration, the disabled flag and the onPowerOff callback through props. The red icon colour and the fixed 224px track width are set in the source.
weight: light: One track, one draggable knob and a per-frame CSS variable for the shimmer.
demo: A lock screen showing 9:41, Tuesday, June 10, and a Cancel line under the bar.
issues: The knob is a focusable div with no role, aria-label or key handler, so it cannot be operated without a pointer.
The shimmer label drops to a very pale grey on the grey track, so it is hard to read at the dim end of its sweep.
polishWhy: Convincing iOS-style track and knob; the shimmer label is low contrast in its dim phase.
